Model A has incorrect backrest shape and missing seam details; Model B has incorrect backrest shape with an oval cutout and simplified seat geometry.

Model A has incorrect dial details (e.g., missing moon phase symbol, wrong hands), simplified decorative patterns, and a less detailed crown. Model B has a more accurate crown shape but incorrect dial details (e.g., wrong hour markers, missing moon phase symbol) and simplified decorative patterns.
